subject: Unable to get fitted values from hurdle_lognormal model

messages.author: e092355034cc4723
messages.subject: Unable to get fitted values from hurdle_lognormal model
parts:
Hi,

I set up a hurdle log-normal model as to test if variable Y is related to X as log(Y) = a + b*log(X):

mod3 <- brm(bf(Y ~ log(X) * E * T +
                     (1+log(X) | Species) + (1|u)),
                data = dat,
                family = hurdle_lognormal(link = "identity",
                                          link_sigma = "log", link_hu = "logit"),
                iter = 500, chains = 3, warmup = 200,
                cores = 4, save_model = "mod-3.txt")

This model compiles and converges successfully. However, I am running into issues on two fronts:

1. I cannot seem to extract the fitted values, to which I get the following error message:

> fit.brm <- fitted(brmod3.3, newdata = dat1, re_formula = NA)
Error in mu + sigma^2/2 : non-conformable arrays


2. Next, when I tried to instead use predict(mod3, newdata = dat1), I get predicted lines that look jagged. Moreover, the lower CI is always 0.

Am I making a mistake in model specification for the hurdle log-normal? I tried doing a quick google search for the error but am unable to fix it. Further, I couldn't figure out why the predicted lines are jagged. Any insights will be much appreciated!

Thanks,
Meghna
